name: search-hub
description: Search Hub CLI surface. Single source of truth for the `providers` domain: schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1 and cross-validated against the RegistryService proto descriptor at test time. Loaded by cli/main.go via cliapp.LoadFromManifest.

groups.name: query
groups.description: Federated search across registered providers (router domain)

commands.name: query
commands.description: Search registered providers and return results grouped by provider

flags.name: type
flags.description: Comma-separated leaf types to route to (e.g. command,doc,record)

flags.name: all
flags.description: Fan out to every active provider

flags.name: group
flags.description: Scope the fan-out to one scenario's leaves

flags.name: explain
flags.description: Include the routing rationale (which selector chose the providers)

groups.name: providers
groups.description: Register, list, and remove federated search providers (registry domain)

flags.name: descriptor
flags.description: ProviderDescriptor as JSON, or @path to a JSON file

flags.name: type
flags.description: Filter by leaf type (command, doc, record, …)

groups.name: federation
groups.description: Federation status: per-provider reachability + classifier/reranker availability (routing domain)

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show each active provider's reachability and whether the classifier/reranker models are available

groups.name: insights
groups.description: Federation telemetry insights: utilization, zero-result rate, latency percentiles (metrics domain)

commands.name: insights
commands.description: Aggregate per-query telemetry into federation-health signals (under-utilized providers, zero-result rate, p50/p95 latency)

flags.name: window
flags.description: Restrict aggregates to the last N days (0 or unset = all-time)
